purpose: Protocol-bounded, non-ranking editorial sample of large employing legal entities with auditable official evidence.
non_ranking_statement: Selection order is a deterministic editorial processing order, not a revenue rank, complete market census, probability sample, or claim of global representativeness.

classification.domestic_rule: The employing legal entity is incorporated in KR and has its registered head office in KR.
classification.international_rule: The employing legal entity is incorporated outside KR and has its registered head office outside KR in a panel country.
classification.related_entity_rule: A parent and subsidiary may both qualify only with separate scale evidence and entity-specific benefit evidence; group policy is never inherited without applicability evidence.

thresholds.public_sector_rule: Public ownership or institution type does not auto-qualify an entity; the same sector threshold applies.

currency_conversion.rule: For non-USD international statements, use the official annual local-currency-per-USD factor for the fiscal year, preserve the reported value and currency, and reject a record if the required country-year factor is unavailable.

canonical_selection.normalization: Unicode NFC; trim every string; collapse internal legal_name whitespace to one ASCII space
canonical_selection.serialization: Compact UTF-8 JSON array [protocol_seed,jurisdiction,registry_id,legal_name] with ensure_ascii=false, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=false
canonical_selection.missing_value_rule: Reject; never substitute an empty string.
canonical_selection.order: Ascending hash; on collision ascending canonical JSON bytes.
canonical_selection.exclusion_rule: Append an exclusion/replacement event; do not mutate immutable selected records.
canonical_selection.replacement_rule: Use the next unused eligible canonical-hash record in the same scope.
canonical_selection.next_hash_rule: Each event records previous_effective_sha256 and next_effective_sha256; research cannot resume until the next hash is explicitly approved.

immutable_model.state_rule: These files are prohibited while status is blocked. After lawful acquisition and validation, selected ledgers are immutable; effective ledgers are deterministic projections of selected ledgers plus append-only events.

coverage_gap.KR: OpenDART, FTC and Cleaneye API acquisition requires user-owned service keys; no complete eligible union has been acquired.
coverage_gap.US: Official bulk sources are public, but the complete candidate/financial union and reuse snapshot have not been acquired and validated.
coverage_gap.CA: SEDAR+ bulk distribution is licensed; public provincial lists do not provide a complete national bulk financial population.
coverage_gap.MX: Official CNBV interfaces are public but bulk endpoints are undocumented and reuse terms are unresolved.
coverage_gap.BR: Official CVM/CNPJ open data is available, but the complete joined population has not been acquired and validated.
coverage_gap.AR: Official CNV interfaces are public but undocumented for bulk use and reuse terms are unresolved.
coverage_gap.GB: Companies House bulk products are available, but the complete eligible population has not been acquired and validated.
coverage_gap.FR: INPI RNE bulk/API access requires an account and complete acquisition has not occurred.
coverage_gap.DE: Entity-level official financial bulk access is constrained by register access, per-document retrieval and reuse conditions.
coverage_gap.IT: Official entity financial access is contractual or paid; no lawful complete bulk acquisition is approved.
coverage_gap.TR: KAP bulk/commercial reuse terms require review or contract; public pages are not an approved bulk feed.
coverage_gap.RU: Official bulk accounting data is subscription/contractual and reuse terms are unresolved.
coverage_gap.AU: ASIC identity bulk data is open, but official entity-level financial evidence at required scale has not been acquired.
coverage_gap.CN: Exchange and regulator sources restrict or do not document bulk/commercial reuse; complete lawful acquisition is unresolved.
coverage_gap.IN: Official issuer and public-enterprise sources are available, but terms and complete joined acquisition are unresolved.
coverage_gap.ID: IDX filing access is official, but bulk reuse and complete acquisition are unresolved.
coverage_gap.JP: EDINET API requires a user subscription key; no complete acquisition has occurred.
coverage_gap.SA: Saudi Exchange official access and reuse controls do not establish an approved bulk acquisition path.
coverage_gap.ZA: CIPC disclosure is fee-based and JSE structured financial feeds are commercial licensed products.

blockers.requirement: Provide user-owned OpenDART and data.go.kr service keys and authorize lawful acquisition.
Obtain and review required bulk licences/contracts/fees before acquisition.
Approve lawful, reproducible entity-level financial acquisition paths and reuse decisions.
Provide user-owned API/subscription keys where official APIs require them.
Acquire, checksum and validate every official list union and qualifying scale metric for all scopes.
After materialization, explicitly approve protocol, eligible-ledger hashes, immutable selected-ledger hashes, and initial effective-ledger hashes.
